messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: beware of new rstudio
parts:
the new rstudio released yesterday looks very nice. autocompletion at the levels of sql editors incl in the dplyr chains which is very nifty. the filters used by dataTables in shiny are now in the View console which is very handy to sift through the data. but the old problem of hebrew in dataTables just got very important. you cant see the hebrew since dataTables work on js and cant account for utf-8. see attached for an example.

so now my question from a few days ago is actually going to to become a big issue in the new rstudio.

any solutions you guys can think of?

yoni
